Messages.Author: Henrik Isaksson
Messages.Body:

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>Two player game, you have one minion, your prey has one minion. What's the
>lowest amount you can
>bleed for?

You control Martin Franckel, the other player controls Greta Kircher.

Martin Clan Impersonates into Clan Gangrel. You play 89 Gangrel De-Evolutions
on him. The other player plays 88 Gangrel Atavisms on Martin.

Martin bleeds, your prey burns a Dummy Corporation and plays a Telepathic
Counter and burns a blood using Greta's special.

So the amount is 1 (base) - 1 (Martin) - 2 (Dummy Corp) - 2 (Telepathic
Counter) - 1 (Greta) - 89 (De-Evolution) - 88 (Atavism) = -182 bleed.

=P

Halcyan 2

> Matthias removes his Clan impersonation setting him back to Salubri (Martin's Special kicks in, and it enables Banner of Neutrality below).

Martin Clan Impersonates to Gangrel.
Matthias's controller gives Martin Gangrel Atavism (-1)
Martin burns his CI and reverts his clan.
Martin gets a Necromancy master (or gets the Sargon Fragment, either
way)
Martin plays Whispers of the Dead to get the Clan Impersonate back.

-15 bleed. You can get it to -18 if either player plays a Succubus
Club, allowing Martin's controller to pass Matthias's controller his
copy of Monomancy, Gangrel Atavism and Steal the Mind, which
Matthias's controller stacks onto Martin at an appropriate point.

-John Flournoy
